{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: build-freedom
on:
  push:
    paths:
    - 'nob.c'
    - 'freedom/**'
    - 'include/**'
    - 'vendor/**'
  workflow_dispatch:
    paths:
    - 'nob.c'
    - 'freedom/**'
    - 'include/**'
    - 'vendor/**'

jobs:
  windows-msvc-lazer:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - name: build
        shell: cmd
        run: |
          for /f "delims=" %%i in ('"C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe" -latest -products * -requires Microsoft.VisualStudio.Component.VC.Tools.x86.x64 -property installationPath') do call "%%i\VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvarsall.bat" x64 && cl.exe nob.c && .\nob.exe
      - name: upload-lazer
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: freedom-lazer
          path: |
            injector-lazer.exe
            freedom-lazer.dll
  windows-msvc-lazer-debug:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - name: build
        shell: cmd
        run: |
          for /f "delims=" %%i in ('"C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe" -latest -products * -requires Microsoft.VisualStudio.Component.VC.Tools.x86.x64 -property installationPath') do call "%%i\VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvarsall.bat" x64 && cl.exe nob.c && .\nob.exe -debug -console
      - name: upload-lazer-debug
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: freedom-lazer-debug
          path: |
            injector-lazer.exe
            freedom-lazer.dll
  windows-msvc-legacy:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - name: build
        shell: cmd
        run: |
          for /f "delims=" %%i in ('"C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe" -latest -products * -requires Microsoft.VisualStudio.Component.VC.Tools.x86.x64 -property installationPath') do call "%%i\VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvarsall.bat" x86 && cl.exe nob.c && .\nob.exe
      - name: upload-legacy
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: freedom-legacy
          path: |
            injector-legacy.exe
            freedom-legacy.dll
  windows-msvc-legacy-debug:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - name: build
        shell: cmd
        run: |
          for /f "delims=" %%i in ('"C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe" -latest -products * -requires Microsoft.VisualStudio.Component.VC.Tools.x86.x64 -property installationPath') do call "%%i\VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvarsall.bat" x86 && cl.exe nob.c && .\nob.exe -debug -console
      - name: upload-legacy-debug
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: freedom-legacy-debug
          path: |
            injector-legacy.exe
            freedom-legacy.dll",
  "rationale": "The workflow has four Windows build jobs with no job-level timeout, so a hung or runaway build can consume the full default runner duration. The P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT pattern (bound jobs with a custom timeout) is supported by the pattern catalogue and by experiment records batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508 and batch-interactive-three--112e2b2e7fbe04b8, which added timeout-minutes to jobs and reported reduced runaway consumption. Adding timeout-minutes: 30 to each job is a minimal, workflow-scoped change that preserves all four build jobs, all compile steps, and all artifact uploads unchanged. It does not alter permissions, add secrets, introduce network access, or add publishing/deployment operations. The 30-minute budget provides operational headroom for MSVC compilation and artifact upload while bounding runaway consumption; false timeout failures should be monitored separately as the pattern advises.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT", "experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508", "experiment:batch-interactive-three--112e2b2e7fbe04b8"]
}
